hook_text: Can you cover a whole floor with circles? Try it, and look at the gaps.
clip_script: Polokwane, designing a mosaic for the school entrance. Slide a square: translation. Turn a triangle around a corner: rotation. Flip a shape over a line: reflection, a mirror image. Same size, same shape every time. Flip a right-angled triangle over its side: a bigger triangle with a line of symmetry. Slide squares in rows: a floor with no gaps. Triangles fit point up, point down. Hexagons make a honeycomb. Circles? Always gaps. That is a tessellation: no gaps, no overlaps.
visual_style: Card shapes sliding, turning and flipping into place, then a floor filling with tiles and circles leaving gaps.
mood: Creative and satisfying, like an artist laying tiles.
pacing: Three moves, the symmetry trick, then the tiling test.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and design a tessellating tile on grid paper.
